section_1_cloze.passage:
Since the beginning of my Ph.D., my life had been packed with activities. Besides working full-time on my own research, I [41] my colleagues' experiments by helping with tasks like data analysis. questions.explanation: 上下文提到“helping with tasks...”，说明作者在“帮助”同事做实验。aid 意为“帮助，援助”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(graded)：语境句：The teacher graded the exams quickly. 固定搭配：grade papers, grade tests
B(aided)：语境句：The organization aided the victims of the earthquake. 固定搭配：aid sb in doing sth, first aid
C(funded)：语境句：The government funded the new research project. 固定搭配：fund a project, fully funded
D(scheduled)：语境句：The meeting is scheduled for Monday. 固定搭配：schedule a meeting, ahead of schedule

questions.explanation: 安排紧凑的时间表需要“应付/管理”。manage a tight schedule 意为“管理紧凑的日程”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(assign)：语境句：The teacher will assign homework every Friday. 固定搭配：assign tasks, assign sb to do
B(manage)：语境句：She knows how to manage her time effectively. 固定搭配：manage a schedule, manage to do
C(delay)：语境句：The flight was delayed due to bad weather. 固定搭配：delay doing sth, without delay
D(decline)：语境句：He politely declined the invitation to the party. 固定搭配：decline an offer, in decline

questions.explanation: 作者最初认为能应付紧凑的日程是自己“能力”的体现。competence 意为“能力，胜任”，符合语境逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a lot of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience
B(competence)：语境句：The manager praised her professional competence. 固定搭配：core competence, demonstrate competence
C(knowledge)：语境句：Reading books expands our knowledge of the world. 固定搭配：acquire knowledge, common knowledge
D(ambition)：语境句：His ambition is to become a successful entrepreneur. 固定搭配：achieve one's ambition, full of ambition

questions.explanation: 破折号后解释“无法在所有任务中投入最好的状态”，说明注意力被“分散”了。divided 意为“分散的，分裂的”。
questions.supplement:
A(drawn)：语境句：His attention was drawn to the loud noise outside. 固定搭配：draw attention to, be drawn to
B(focused)：语境句：Stay focused on your goals to achieve success. 固定搭配：focus on, stay focused
C(divided)：语境句：The committee was divided on the new policy. 固定搭配：divide into, divided attention
D(directed)：语境句：The police officer directed the traffic at the intersection. 固定搭配：direct attention to, direct a film

questions.explanation: 呼应第一段的“tasks like data analysis”，指代前文提到的各种工作“任务”。
questions.supplement:
A(achievements)：语境句：We are proud of her academic achievements. 固定搭配：make achievements, outstanding achievements
B(courses)：语境句：I signed up for two elective courses this semester. 固定搭配：take a course, online courses
C(rewards)：语境句：Hard work will eventually bring great rewards. 固定搭配：reap the rewards, financial rewards
D(tasks)：语境句：He completed all his daily tasks before leaving the office. 固定搭配：accomplish a task, assign tasks

questions.explanation: 同事对作者说“你需要重新评估工作方式”，这是一种“建议”。suggest 意为“建议”。
questions.supplement:
A(ordered)：语境句：The commander ordered the soldiers to advance. 固定搭配：order sb to do, place an order
B(blamed)：语境句：She blamed him for the failure of the project. 固定搭配：blame sb for sth, take the blame
C(suggested)：语境句：He suggested taking a walk after dinner. 固定搭配：suggest doing sth, strongly suggest
D(investigated)：语境句：The police investigated the cause of the fire. 固定搭配：investigate a case, thoroughly investigate

questions.explanation: 结合前文作者处于极度疲劳(burnt out)状态，同事建议作者“慢下来”。slow down 意为“放慢节奏”。
questions.supplement:
A(slow down)：语境句：You need to slow down and take a rest. 固定搭配：slow down the pace, slow down a bit
B(hang on)：语境句：Hang on a minute, I'll be right back. 固定搭配：hang on to, hang on a second
C(cheer up)：语境句：He bought her some flowers to cheer her up. 固定搭配：cheer up, cheer sb up
D(fight back)：语境句：It takes courage to fight back against bullying. 固定搭配：fight back tears, fight back against

questions.explanation: 为了划清工作界限，晚上作者会让工作手机保持“不被触碰/不用”的状态。untouched 意为“未触碰的”。
questions.supplement:
A(untouched)：语境句：The food on his plate remained untouched. 固定搭配：leave sth untouched, remain untouched
B(uncharged)：语境句：My phone died because it was left uncharged. 固定搭配：uncharged battery, remain uncharged
C(unpaid)：语境句：She took unpaid leave to care for her sick mother. 固定搭配：unpaid bills, unpaid work
D(unlocked)：语境句：Make sure not to leave the front door unlocked. 固定搭配：leave unlocked, an unlocked phone

questions.explanation: 作者开始在工作时间周围设定明确的“界限”。set boundaries 意为“设定界限”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(guidelines)：语境句：Please strictly follow the safety guidelines. 固定搭配：strict guidelines, draw up guidelines
B(deadlines)：语境句：We have to work overtime to meet the deadlines. 固定搭配：meet a deadline, miss a deadline
C(goals)：语境句：Setting clear goals is essential for success. 固定搭配：achieve a goal, set goals
D(boundaries)：语境句：It is important to set healthy boundaries in a relationship. 固定搭配：set boundaries, push the boundaries

questions.explanation: 作者对承担的项目变得更加“有选择性”，不再什么工作都接。selective 意为“有选择性的，挑剔的”。
questions.supplement:
A(selective)：语境句：Universities are highly selective when admitting students. 固定搭配：be selective about, highly selective
B(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
C(confident)：语境句：She feels confident about passing the driving test. 固定搭配：be confident in/about, highly confident
D(anxious)：语境句：He was anxious about the outcome of the interview. 固定搭配：be anxious about, feel anxious

questions.explanation: 起初作者觉得做得比别人少，担心这种选择会“影响”自己的职业生涯。affect 意为“影响”。
questions.supplement:
A(launch)：语境句：The company plans to launch a new product next month. 固定搭配：launch a product, launch an attack
B(improve)：语境句：Regular exercise can improve your physical health. 固定搭配：improve significantly, room for improvement
C(affect)：语境句：Lack of sleep will negatively affect your performance. 固定搭配：greatly affect, affect the outcome
D(lengthen)：语境句：Stretching exercises help to lengthen your muscles. 固定搭配：lengthen the lifespan, lengthen significantly

questions.explanation: 随着作者花更多时间“喘息/放松”和反思，事情变得清晰。breathe 此处引申为“放松，喘息”。
questions.supplement:
A(research)：语境句：Scientists continue to research into the causes of the disease. 固定搭配：do research on, scientific research
B(experiment)：语境句：They decided to experiment with a new teaching method. 固定搭配：experiment with, do an experiment
C(breathe)：语境句：Take a moment to step outside and breathe deeply. 固定搭配：breathe deeply, breathe life into
D(battle)：语境句：The doctors are battling to save the patient's life. 固定搭配：battle against, an uphill battle

questions.explanation: 后文提到“我意识到自己真的很喜欢培训学生……”，这是上文“优先事项变得清晰”的具体例子。For instance 意为“例如”。
questions.supplement:
A(For instance)：语境句：There are many healthy foods; for instance, apples and broccoli. 固定搭配：for instance, take... for instance
B(In addition)：语境句：In addition, the hotel offers a free breakfast. 固定搭配：in addition to, in addition
C(By contrast)：语境句：By contrast, the city's northern part is much wealthier. 固定搭配：by contrast, in contrast to
D(As always)：语境句：As always, he arrived exactly on time. 固定搭配：as always

questions.explanation: 最终，这种工作方式和心态上的“改变”使作者效率更高。change 意为“改变”。
questions.supplement:
A(belief)：语境句：She has a strong belief in the power of education. 固定搭配：beyond belief, strong belief
B(training)：语境句：The new employees are currently undergoing training. 固定搭配：provide training, physical training
C(purchase)：语境句：He made a significant purchase by buying a new car. 固定搭配：make a purchase, purchase online
D(change)：语境句：The change in weather caught everyone by surprise. 固定搭配：make a change, significant change

questions.explanation: 为自己创造空间（放慢节奏）并不是“落后”的标志，而是专注真正重要事物的方法。falling behind 意为“落后”。
questions.supplement:
A(showing off)：语境句：He drove his new sports car just to show off. 固定搭配：show off, a show-off
B(breaking down)：语境句：The car ended up breaking down in the middle of nowhere. 固定搭配：break down, mental breakdown
C(fading away)：语境句：As time went on, the memories started fading away. 固定搭配：fade away, fade into the background
D(falling behind)：语境句：If you miss too many classes, you risk falling behind. 固定搭配：fall behind schedule, fall behind in class

vocab_pack.definition_en: filled with; containing a lot of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文使用过去完成时的被动语态（had been packed with），表示过去某一时间之前的状态，强调被塞满了活动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The stadium was packed with excited fans.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 体育场挤满了兴奋的粉丝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my life had been packed with activities

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spend all of one's working hours on a particular activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文为现在分词短语（working full-time on），在句中作伴随状语，表示在攻读博士期间的全职工作状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to work full-time on her own startup.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定全职投入自己的初创公司。
vocab_pack.from_passage: working full-time on my own research

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help or support
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用一般过去时（aided），表示过去帮助同事的实验。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new software aids doctors in diagnosing diseases.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款新软件帮助医生诊断疾病。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I aided my colleagues' experiments

vocab_pack.definition_en: to assist in doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文为现在分词短语（helping with），与前面的 aiding 并列，表示通过帮助数据分析等任务来协助同事。
vocab_pack.example_en: Can you help with the dishes?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能帮忙洗碗吗？
vocab_pack.from_passage: helping with tasks like data analysis

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go to an event, course, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用一般过去时（attended），表示过去参加每一门能上的课程。
vocab_pack.example_en: All students must attend the morning assembly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有学生必须参加晨会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I attended every course that I could

vocab_pack.definition_en: to successfully organize one's time when there is very little free time
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 管理紧张的日程；应对紧凑的时间表
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 manage a tight schedule 作为不定式短语（to manage...）的宾语补足语，表达作者认为管理紧凑时间表是能力的体现。
vocab_pack.example_en: She learned to manage a tight schedule while working two jobs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她边做着两份工作边学会了管理紧张的日程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my ability to manage a tight schedule

vocab_pack.definition_en: a sign or indicator of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 a measure of 作为表语，说明管理日程的能力被看作是衡量能力的标准。
vocab_pack.example_en: Winning the award was a measure of his hard work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 获得这个奖项是他努力工作的体现。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a measure of my competence

vocab_pack.definition_en: the ability to do something well
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 competence 为不可数名词，作介词 of 的宾语，表示我的能力。
vocab_pack.example_en: The job requires a high level of technical competence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份工作要求高水平的专业技术能力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a measure of my competence

vocab_pack.definition_en: clearly true; impossible to deny
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 undeniable 作定语修饰 truth，强调这个真相无法否认。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her talent is undeniable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的才华是不可否认的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an undeniable truth

vocab_pack.definition_en: exhausted physically or emotionally because of overwork
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 精疲力竭的；心力交瘁的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 was burnt out 为主系表结构，burnt out 是过去分词转化来的形容词，描述主语的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: After working for 12 hours straight, he felt completely burnt out.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 连续工作12小时后，他感觉完全精疲力竭了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was burnt out

vocab_pack.definition_en: split into different parts; not concentrated
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 was divided 为被动语态，但此处 divided 主要作形容词表语，说明注意力被分散。
vocab_pack.example_en: With so many distractions, my attention was divided.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有这么多干扰，我的注意力被分散了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My attention was divided

vocab_pack.definition_en: to devote one's maximum effort to something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 把最好的精力/工作投入……
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文为否定结构 couldn't put my best work into，表示无法把最好的努力投入所有任务。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should always put your best work into every project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该始终把最好的精力投入每一个项目中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I couldn't put my best work into all the tasks

vocab_pack.definition_en: a serious mistake
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 a major error 作介词 after 的宾语，表示在发生了一个重大错误之后。
vocab_pack.example_en: One major error in the calculation led to the project's failure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 计算中的一个重大错误导致了项目的失败。
vocab_pack.from_passage: after a major error in my research paper

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put forward an idea or plan for consideration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用一般过去时 suggested，后接直接引语，表示同事提出了建议。
vocab_pack.example_en: I suggest we take a short break.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我建议我们休息一会儿。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a colleague came and suggested

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think about something again in order to decide if changes are needed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 reassess 为不定式（to reassess），在建议中作为谓语动词，表示重新评估你的工作方法。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to reassess our strategy after the market changes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 市场变化后，我们需要重新评估我们的策略。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You need to reassess your working approach

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce speed or activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 slow down 为不定式（to slow down），是建议的另一部分，表示你需要放慢节奏。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor advised him to slow down and take a vacation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生建议他放慢节奏，去度个假。
vocab_pack.from_passage: you need to slow down

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow someone's suggestion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用一般过去时 took his advice，表示作者采纳了同事的建议。
vocab_pack.example_en: If you take my advice, you won't make that mistake again.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你听我的建议，就不会再犯那个错误了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I took his advice

vocab_pack.definition_en: to buy something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用一般过去时 purchased，表示作者买了一台分开的工作手机。
vocab_pack.example_en: She purchased a new laptop for online classes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她为网课购买了一台新笔记本电脑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I purchased a separate work phone

vocab_pack.definition_en: forming a unit by itself; not joined to something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 separate 作定语修饰 work phone，表示独立分开的工作手机。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please keep these documents in a separate folder.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请把这些文件放在一个单独的文件夹里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a separate work phone

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something in its original state; not to use or change it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 leave untouched 为动词+宾语补足语结构，would leave（过去将来时）表示晚上会让手机保持不被触碰的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: He left the food untouched on the plate.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他把食物原封不动地留在盘子里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: leave untouched in the evenings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish limits regarding what is acceptable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用不定式 started to set clear boundaries，表示开始设定关于工作时间的明确界限。
vocab_pack.example_en: You need to set boundaries between work and personal life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你需要在工作和个人生活之间设定界限。
vocab_pack.from_passage: set clear boundaries around my work hours

vocab_pack.definition_en: choosing carefully; not accepting everything
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文为 became more selective about，系表结构 + 比较级，表示作者对承接的项目变得更加有选择性。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is very selective about the movies she watches.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她看电影很挑剔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: became more selective about the projects I took on

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept (a job, responsibility, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中后置定语从句 I took on 为一般过去时，修饰 projects，表示我承接的项目。
vocab_pack.example_en: He decided to take on more responsibilities at work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他决定承担更多工作职责。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the projects I took on

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be afraid of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 fearing 为现在分词，作伴随状语，表示在担心这个选择可能会影响职业。
vocab_pack.example_en: She fears losing her job if she takes a break.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她害怕如果休息会丢掉工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fearing this choice might affect my career

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an influence on someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 affect 为虚拟语气（might affect），表示担心可能影响职业生涯。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new law will affect everyone's daily life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新法律将影响每个人的日常生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: might affect my career

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take air into and out of the lungs; to pause and relax
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 breathe 为不定式（to breathe），与 reflect on 并列，表示花时间呼吸和反思。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a long day, I just want to breathe and calm down.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 漫长的一天过后，我只想喘口气，冷静下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: took more time to breathe and reflect on my work

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think carefully about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 reflect on 为不定式（to reflect on），与 breathe 并列，表示花时间反思工作。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should reflect on our mistakes and learn from them.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该反思自己的错误并从中学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: reflect on my work

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get pleasure from doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 enjoyed training 为一般过去时，enjoy 后接动名词短语 training the students，表示喜欢培训学生。
vocab_pack.example_en: He enjoys reading novels in his free time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他喜欢在空闲时间读小说。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I really enjoyed training the students

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: invest more time and effort in them
vocab_pack.definition_en: to devote time and energy to something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文用 started to invest more time and effort in them，不定式结构，表示开始在他们身上投入更多时间和精力。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should invest more time and effort in learning English.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该在学英语上投入更多时间和精力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: invest more time and effort in them

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the end; finally
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 Ultimately 作独立副词，位于句首，表示最终这个改变使他变得更高效。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ultimately, your hard work will pay off.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 归根结底，你的努力会有回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ultimately, this change made me more productive

vocab_pack.definition_en: producing or able to produce good results
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文为比较级 more productive，作宾语补足语，说明这个改变让作者变得更有成效。
vocab_pack.example_en: A tidy workspace makes you more productive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 整洁的工作空间让你更高效。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made me more productive

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fail to keep up with others or one's plans
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 falling behind 为动名词短语，作介词 of 的宾语，表示……不是落后的标志。
vocab_pack.example_en: If you miss class, you will fall behind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你缺课，就会落后。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a sign of falling behind

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be important to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：原文中 matters to you 是定语从句中的谓语，主语 what，第三人称单数现时，表示真正对你重要的事情。
vocab_pack.example_en: Family always matters to me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 家庭对我来说永远很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what truly matters to you

section_2_word_form.passage:
The oasis (绿洲) valley seems strangely at odds with the common impression of Saudi Arabia. Make no mistake, the desert is here, but so [56] breathtaking green landscapes. Even the area's spelling is unusual — AlUla.

AlUla's [57] not only lies in its natural scenery but in its cultural and historic heritage (遗产). In AlUla, besides the ancient city of Dadan, tourists can visit the Hegra archaeological site, which is both Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site [58] home to astonishing Nabataean rock-cut tombs with delicate decorations and carvings.

[59] this year, AlUla welcomed 263,000 visitors from China. Recognizing the significant potential for growth in Chinese market, the tourism section of AlUla, [60] local businesses, is seeking to strengthen its presence in China by organizing promotional events and participating in travel [61]. Abdulrahman Alsuhaibani, vice president of culture at the Royal Commission for AlUla, says, “We've adopted a varied strategy to meet the needs of Chinese tourists, [62] features cultural, historical and luxury experiences.”

The authority has also worked [63] Chinese museums to focus on areas like cultural heritage preservation and promotion. Recently, AlUla, Wonder of Arabia, an exhibition held at the Palace Museum, presented [64] overview of the area's history through 236 exhibits. Moreover, at the AlUla Language Institute, founded in 2021, Saudis can learn Chinese [65] communication with tourists.

questions.explanation: "so + 助动词/be动词 + 主语" 结构表示“……也是如此”。主语是复数名词 breathtaking green landscapes，且根据前句 "the desert is here" 确定时态为一般现在时，故填 are。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are)：语境句：She is a doctor, and so are her parents. 固定搭配：so are we, there are。原词be其它变形：is(单数), was/were(过去式), been(过去分词), being(现在分词)。

questions.explanation: 所属格 AlUla's 后面需要接名词作主语。unique 的名词形式为 uniqueness，意为“独特性”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(uniqueness)：语境句：The uniqueness of this artwork makes it extremely valuable. 固定搭配：cultural uniqueness。原词unique其它变形：uniquely(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查固定连词搭配 both... and...，连接两个并列成分。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The task is both challenging and rewarding. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。

questions.explanation: 考查固定时间状语表达 "earlier this year"，意为“今年早些时候”。句首首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Earlier)：语境句：Earlier this year, the company launched a new product. 固定搭配：earlier than expected, much earlier。原词early其它变形：earliest(最高级)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。主语 the tourism section 与 partner 之间是主动关系，表示“与……合作”，用现在分词 partnering 作伴随状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(partnering)：语境句：The school is partnering with local companies to offer internships. 固定搭配：partner with, business partner。原词partner其它变形：partners(复数), partnered(过去式/过去分词)。

questions.explanation: fair 此处意为“展销会，博览会”，为可数名词。travel fair 表示“旅游博览会”，根据语境，参加的是泛指的多个博览会，故用复数形式 fairs。
questions.supplement: 正确形(fairs)：语境句：She traveled around the world to attend international trade fairs. 固定搭配：job fair, book fair。原词fair其它变形：fairly(adv.), fairness(n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。先行词是 strategy，指物，在从句中作主语，故用关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He proposed a new strategy, which proved to be highly effective. 固定搭配：in which, of which。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。work with sb 意为“与某人合作”，此处指与中国博物馆合作。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：She works closely with a team of researchers. 固定搭配：work with, communicate with。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。overview 为可数名词单数，表示“一个概述”，且以元音音素 /əʊ/ 开头，故用不定冠词 an。
questions.supplement: 正确形(an)：语境句：The manager gave us an overview of the company's financial status. 固定搭配：give an overview of, provide an overview。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处表示学习中文的目的是“使沟通顺畅”，用动词不定式作目的状语。smooth 此处作动词，意为“使平稳，使顺畅”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to smooth)：语境句：The new policy was introduced to smooth the transition process. 固定搭配：smooth the way for, smooth things over。原词smooth其它变形：smoothly(adv.), smoothness(n.), smoothed(过去式)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in conflict or disagreement with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句作表语，与系动词seems连用，说明主语的状况；介词短语，with后接名词the common impression。
vocab_pack.example_en: His behavior is at odds with his principles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的行为与他的原则不一致。
vocab_pack.from_passage: seems strangely at odds with the common impression

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is true; do not be mistaken
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 祈使句，固定表达，用于加强语气；句中大写首字母，独立使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: Make no mistake, this is the best opportunity you'll get.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 别弄错了，这是你能得到的最好机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Make no mistake, the desert is here

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely beautiful or impressive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰green landscapes；表示程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: The view from the summit is breathtaking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。
vocab_pack.from_passage: breathtaking green landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to exist or be found in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句一般现在时，主语uniqueness为第三人称单数，谓语用lies in；后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The charm of this city lies in its history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市的魅力在于它的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: AlUla's uniqueness not only lies in its natural scenery

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to connect two things, with the second being equally or more important
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句中省略了also，连接两个并列的介词短语in its natural scenery和in its cultural and historic heritage；注意平行结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is not only a teacher but also a writer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她不仅是一名教师，还是一名作家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not only lies in its natural scenery but in its cultural and historic heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: valued objects and qualities such as cultural traditions; inheritance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，此处与cultural and historic搭配，作介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Great Wall is a part of China's cultural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长城是中国文化遗产的一部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cultural and historic heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: a city that existed in ancient times
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，由形容词ancient修饰city，后接of引出名称；本句中作介词besides的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient city of Pompeii was buried by volcanic ash.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 庞贝古城被火山灰掩埋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: besides the ancient city of Dadan

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place where evidence of past human activity is studied
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，archaeological为形容词修饰site；本句中作visit的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The archaeological site contains the ruins of a Roman temple.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该考古遗址包含一座罗马神庙的遗迹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: visit the Hegra archaeological site

vocab_pack.definition_en: a site designated by UNESCO as having outstanding universal value
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词短语，本句中作表语，位于both…and结构中；UNESCO限定。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Taj Mahal is a World Heritage Site.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 泰姬陵是世界遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: both Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site

vocab_pack.definition_en: serving as the place where something lives or is located
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句用作表语，与is连用，后接名词短语astonishing Nabataean rock-cut tombs；表示该地拥有这些墓葬。
vocab_pack.example_en: The forest is home to many endangered species.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这片森林是许多濒危物种的家园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which is both ... and home to astonishing Nabataean rock-cut tombs

vocab_pack.definition_en: a tomb carved out of solid rock
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词rock-cut修饰tomb；本句为复数形式，作介词to的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Nabataeans built impressive rock-cut tombs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 纳巴泰人建造了令人印象深刻的岩凿墓穴。
vocab_pack.from_passage: astonishing Nabataean rock-cut tombs

vocab_pack.definition_en: fine and intricate adornment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词delicate修饰decoration；本句复数形式，与carvings并列，作with的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The vase is covered with delicate decorations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花瓶上覆盖着精美的装饰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with delicate decorations and carvings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to greet or receive someone in a friendly way; to accept gladly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句一般过去时，主语AlUla，谓语用welcomed；表示过去发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school welcomed the new students with a ceremony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校举行仪式欢迎新生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: AlUla welcomed 263,000 visitors

vocab_pack.definition_en: considerable possibility or capacity for growth
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词significant修饰不可数名词potential；本句中作Recognizing的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new technology has significant potential for improving efficiency.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项新技术在提高效率方面具有巨大潜力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Recognizing the significant potential for growth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join or associate with as a partner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句为现在分词形式，用作插入语，表示主动伴随；partnering后直接接宾语local businesses（不带with）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company partnered with a local firm to expand.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司与一家当地公司合作以扩大规模。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the tourism section of AlUla, partnering local businesses,

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make one's influence or market share stronger in a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语to strengthen…，作is seeking的目的状语；its指代AlUla的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The brand aims to strengthen its presence in emerging markets.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该品牌旨在加强在新兴市场的影响力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is seeking to strengthen its presence in China

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event designed to promote a product, service, or destination
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词promotional修饰event；本句复数形式，作organizing的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company organized several promotional events to launch the product.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司组织了几场推广活动来发布产品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: organizing promotional events

vocab_pack.definition_en: an exhibition where travel destinations and services are showcased
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词travel修饰fair；本句复数形式，作participating in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many countries participate in the annual travel fair in Berlin.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多国家参加柏林年度旅游博览会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: participating in travel fairs

vocab_pack.definition_en: a high-ranking executive below the president in charge of a specific area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，用作同位语，后接of culture说明具体职责。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was appointed vice president of human resources.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她被任命为人力资源副总裁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Abdulrahman Alsuhaibani, vice president of culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to choose and implement a plan of action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句现在完成时（have adopted），主语we，谓语adopted，宾语a varied strategy。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government adopted a new strategy to boost the economy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府采取了一项新策略来刺激经济。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We've adopted a varied strategy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to satisfy the requirements of someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句不定式to meet…作目的状语，修饰strategy；needs为复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new curriculum is designed to meet the needs of all students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新课程旨在满足所有学生的需求。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to meet the needs of Chinese tourists

vocab_pack.definition_en: a high-end, premium activity or service
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词luxury修饰experience；本句复数形式，与cultural, historical并列作features的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel offers luxury experiences such as private spa sessions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店提供奢华体验，如私人水疗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cultural, historical and luxury experiences

vocab_pack.definition_en: an official organization with power to make decisions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句单数，特指AlUla的管理当局，作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The local authority is responsible for public safety.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 地方当局负责公共安全。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The authority has also worked with Chinese museums

vocab_pack.definition_en: the protection and maintenance of cultural heritage
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，由cultural heritage修饰preservation；本句与promotion并列，作focus on的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Funding is needed for cultural heritage preservation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文化遗产保护需要资金。
vocab_pack.from_passage: focus on areas like cultural heritage preservation and promotion

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a general summary or survey
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句一般过去时，主语an exhibition，谓语presented，宾语an overview。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report presents an overview of the current situation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该报告概述了当前状况。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented an overview of the area's history

vocab_pack.definition_en: an object or collection on display in a museum
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句复数形式，作介词through的宾语，与236连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum has a fascinating exhibit on ancient Egypt.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆有一个关于古埃及的精彩展览。
vocab_pack.from_passage: through 236 exhibits

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish or create an institution
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句过去分词，用作后置定语修饰the AlUla Language Institute，表示被动（被建立于2021年）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The college was founded in 1850.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学院成立于1850年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the AlUla Language Institute, founded in 2021,

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something smooth; to facilitate or make easier
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句不定式to smooth，作learn Chinese的目的状语，后接宾语communication。
vocab_pack.example_en: The mediator helped smooth the negotiations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 调解人帮助使谈判顺利进行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to smooth communication with tourists

vocab_pack.definition_en: a stretch of natural scenery
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句复数形式，与breathtaking green搭配，作主语补足语（与are连用）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The landscape of the countryside is peaceful.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 乡村的风景很宁静。
vocab_pack.from_passage: so are breathtaking green landscapes

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being one of a kind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 本句单数，作主语，后接谓语lies in。
vocab_pack.example_en: The uniqueness of the artwork makes it valuable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这件艺术品的独特性使其有价值。
vocab_pack.from_passage: AlUla's uniqueness

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely surprising or impressive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰Nabataean rock-cut tombs。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magician performed astonishing tricks.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术师表演了令人震惊的把戏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: astonishing Nabataean rock-cut tombs
